query.query: SELECT f.intent, count() AS sessions, count(DISTINCT f.pid) AS people, avg(f.pageviews) AS avg_pages, sum(f.service_visited) AS service_sessions, sum(f.service_tracked) AS service_event_sessions, sum(f.portfolio) AS portfolio_sessions, sum(f.about) AS about_sessions, sum(f.form_started) AS form_starts, sum(f.form_submitted) AS form_submits, sum(f.form_errors) AS form_error_sessions FROM (SELECT $session_id AS sid, any(person_id) AS pid, countIf(event='$pageview') AS pageviews, max(event='whatsapp_click') AS intent, max(event='form_start') AS form_started, max(event='form_submit') AS form_submitted, max(event='form_error') AS form_errors, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/servicios/%') AS service_visited, max(event='service_page_viewed') AS service_tracked, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/obras%') AS portfolio, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname='/nosotros/') AS about, minIf(timestamp,event='whatsapp_click') AS contact_time, minIf(timestamp,event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/obras%') AS portfolio_time FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=328910) GROUP BY sid) f GROUP BY f.intent ORDER BY f.intent DESC

SELECT properties.$pathname AS service_page, countIf(event='$pageview') AS pageviews, countIf(event='service_page_viewed') AS service_events, count(DISTINCT if(event='$pageview',person_id,NULL)) AS viewing_people,count(DISTINCT if(event='service_page_viewed',person_id,NULL)) AS tracked_people FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND event IN ('$pageview','service_page_viewed') AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/servicios/%' AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=328910) GROUP BY service_page ORDER BY pageviews DESC

SELECT f.device, count() AS sessions, sum(f.intent) AS contact_sessions,sum(f.form_started) AS form_starts,sum(f.form_submitted) AS form_submits,sum(f.form_errors) AS error_sessions FROM (SELECT $session_id AS sid, any(person_id) AS pid, argMin(properties.$device_type,timestamp) AS device, countIf(event='$pageview') AS pageviews, max(event='whatsapp_click') AS intent, max(event='form_start') AS form_started, max(event='form_submit') AS form_submitted, max(event='form_error') AS form_errors, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/servicios/%') AS service_visited, max(event='service_page_viewed') AS service_tracked, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/obras%') AS portfolio, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname='/nosotros/') AS about, minIf(timestamp,event='whatsapp_click') AS contact_time, minIf(timestamp,event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/obras%') AS portfolio_time FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=328910) GROUP BY sid) f GROUP BY f.device ORDER BY sessions DESC

SELECT properties.cta_location AS cta, count() AS clicks,count(DISTINCT person_id) AS people, count(DISTINCT $session_id) AS sessions, countIf(properties.lead_source='vipar.com.py') AS internal_source FROM events WHERE event='whatsapp_click' AND timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=328910) GROUP BY cta ORDER BY clicks DESC

query.query: SELECT properties.field_name AS field, properties.error_type AS error, properties.page_path AS page, properties.$device_type AS device, count() AS errors, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS people FROM events WHERE event='form_error' AND timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') GROUP BY field,error,page,device ORDER BY errors DESC

SELECT properties.$prev_pageview_pathname AS page, properties.$device_type AS device, count() AS leaves, countIf(properties.$prev_pageview_max_scroll_percentage IS NOT NULL) AS scroll_measured, avg(toFloat(properties.$prev_pageview_max_scroll_percentage)) AS avg_scroll, quantile(0.5)(toFloat(properties.$prev_pageview_max_scroll_percentage)) AS median_scroll, avg(toFloat(properties.$prev_pageview_duration)) AS avg_seconds FROM events WHERE event='$pageleave' AND timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=328910) GROUP BY page,device ORDER BY leaves DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT properties.$device_type AS device,countIf(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS lcp_n,quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value),properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value IS NOT NULL) AS lcp_p75_ms,countIf(properties.$web_vitals_INP_value IS NOT NULL) AS inp_n,quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_INP_value),properties.$web_vitals_INP_value IS NOT NULL) AS inp_p75_ms,countIf(properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value IS NOT NULL) AS cls_n,quantileIf(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value),properties.$web_vitals_CLS_value IS NOT NULL) AS cls_p75 FROM events WHERE event='$web_vitals' AND timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=328910) GROUP BY device

SELECT $session_id AS session_id,count() AS events,count(DISTINCT uuid) AS event_ids,min(timestamp) AS first_click,max(timestamp) AS last_click,dateDiff('second',min(timestamp),max(timestamp)) AS seconds,groupArray(properties.cta_location) AS ctas FROM events WHERE event='whatsapp_click' AND timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=328910) GROUP BY session_id HAVING count()>1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15
